source: scripts/word-footnotes-probe.sh: Microsoft Word saved footnote_numbering_docx() and two copies as PDF -- 'start10' with S1's numStart 10 instead of 3, 'no_section_props' with every section's w:footnotePr removed (settings.xml's w:footnotePr numFmt=lowerRoman left) -- and pdftotext -layout read, per note, the mark Word prints before the note's text in the page's note area.
findings: settings.xml's w:footnotePr (numFmt lowerRoman) has NO effect on the marks: with no section saying a format, every note is decimal (no_section_props).
A section's w:footnotePr is not inherited by the next section and does not take what it leaves out from settings.xml: S1 (numStart 3 only) prints decimal 3, 4; S3 (none) decimal.
eachSect restarts at the section's own numStart, else 1 (S2: A, B; S1's numStart is not inherited).
eachPage restarts on every page (S4: 1, 2 on both pages).

A continuous section numbers a note as its own numStart (else 1) plus the count of ALL earlier footnotes in the document, whatever earlier sections restarted or started at: S3 prints 5, 6 with S1 starting at 3 and at 10 alike.
